l1_words.meaning: to attend, to be present at

pattern_explanation: These words look almost identical to common English words, so learners may assume the meanings match. The English look-alikes carry different meanings, and the true meanings must be learned separately.
false_friend_warning: Several of these Spanish words look almost identical to common English words, so students may assume the meanings match when they do not. Matching by appearance alone leads to wrong answers on this card.
